messages:
alex-contractor: Hey team — converting from contractor -> full-time with official FT_start = 2026-11-15. Two quick PTO questions: 1) Do I start accruing from day one as FT or is there a probation hold? 2) I have a contractor holiday stipend for unused days 126. Can any of that carry over or convert to FT PTO? Also worried about year-end blackout (we have a planned shutdown 2026-12-24 to 2026-12-31) 126 — will that affect my accrual/use?
sarah-peopleops: Congrats, Alex! Short answers: 1) FT accrual begins on your first day as FT (no probation hold for accrual) unless role-specific policy says otherwise. 2) Contractor stipends are not automatically converted to PTO. Options: payout (taxed) or one-time credit request to convert up to 3 stipend days -> 1 FT flex day (manager + HR approval). Shutdown: company-wide paid shutdown counts as company holiday, so you donft need to use PTO for those days if you're on payroll for that period.
maria-payroll: FYI payroll cutoffs: to get FT status applied for November pay we need paperwork by 2026-10-25. If you miss that, we can do a retroactive adjustment but it adds a manual job. For conversion/payout, send employee ID in the HR form.
jenny-peopleops-lead: Manager note 126: if Alex is onboarding ramp during Nov-Dec sprint, let's plan coverage. Also the performance cycle blackout (no PTO approvals between 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-27 for review week) could affect any planned time off 126. Alex, can you avoid major time off during that week?
alex-contractor: I can avoid the review blackout week. For the stipend conversion, what's the approval flow and timeline? Would prefer conversion over payout.
sarah-peopleops: Flow: submit conversion request form -> manager approves -> HR reviews eligibility -> payroll executes conversion on next pay run. Timeline typically 23 weeks. Link: https://hr.redwood/convert-stipend (one-time conversion only). I'll attach the conversion template in DM.
maria-payroll: If conversion is approved after payroll cutoff we run manual script: 
``
./payroll_adjust --type=convert_stipend --emp=EAL123 --days=3 --effective=2026-11-15
``
This creates a retro entry. Approval audit must be attached.
sarah-peopleops: Policy note excerpt: 
"Full-time accrual policy (snippet):
- accrual begins on first FT day; pro-rate for partial month
- carryover cap = 10 days if FT by Dec 15; otherwise carryover not permitted except one-time exception by People Ops
- year-end company shutdown is paid company holiday if on payroll during the shutdown window
"
people-ops-bot: Reminder: conversion form required to progress. If you need exception for carryover, file by 2026-12-05.
alex-contractor: Thanks all 126. Filing the convert-stipend form now and will ping @jenny-peopleops-lead for manager approval. Will also aim to meet payroll cutoff. Appreciate the clarity!
